meta.title: Moving the end of a draft RFQ-only round does not break the server
gaps: The requested end time of the current end plus 3600 seconds cannot be expressed; the plan uses {{roundEnd+60}} instead.
the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “the app answers without a server error”

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer moves the round's bid end time with the increase auction time moved later, with the remarks set to “QA round-end extension”.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
